item.text:
Best read: mixed-to-positive. Lula’s 2024 record includes real crisis-mitigation moves on Yanomami, the Rio Grande do Sul floods, hunger, and Gaza, but the on-the-ground picture stayed incomplete in Yanomami territory and drought-hit Amazon communities.
